latest_cos_commentary.headline: Touch Dynamic is a US-based POS hardware manufacturer (touchscreen terminals, kiosks, mobile POS, tablets) selling across restaurant and retail-adjacent verticals, with an emphasis on domestic manufacturing and private-label/OEM programs.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes at the hardware layer of Genius's pos line (terminals, kiosks, peripherals); does not offer software/payments processing of its own based on what was found.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Received a 2026 RSPA VAE Silver award, indicating continued activity in the reseller/VAR channel this year.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant primarily as a hardware alternative or OEM supplier to resellers/VARs rather than a full-stack POS software competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No named restaurant customers, leadership, ownership, or revenue figures were verified in this pass.
